entities.name: Jamira
entities.description: A minotaur geomancer and blacksmith from Aranzhur, daughter of Angrath, student at Strixhaven.

entities.name: Professor Kasmina
entities.description: Professor who recruited the students to steal their sparks.

entities.name: Kequia Akosa
entities.description: Classmate for whom Jamira developed feelings.

entities.name: Orestes
entities.description: Abducted by Jamira under Kasmina's manipulation.

entities.name: Arcavios Preservation Society
entities.description: Group Kasmina manipulated Jamira into working with.

entities.name: Professor Vess
entities.description: Professor who punished the five students.

events.summary: Kasmina recruits Jamira as an ember; Jamira begs her to remove her spark.
events.quote: Afraid, she begged the Professor to remove her spark if possible

events.summary: Kasmina manipulates Jamira into work with the Preservation Society and abducting Orestes.
events.quote: She manipulated Jamira into work with the Arcavios Preservation Society

events.summary: The five students combine their powers and thwart Kasmina's plot; Kasmina presumably dies in a snarl.
events.quote: This plot was thwarted by the five students combining their powers

events.summary: Professor Vess lets the students stay as residential advisors.
events.quote: She allowed them to stay on and pledge to their individual colleges

relations.quote: She is the daughter of the planeswalker Angrath
to rob their sparks to reignite her own
